description: This file defines interfaces, extension methods, and a class for configuring recoverable streams in Orleans, specifically for silo instances. It includes configuration setup for statistics and cache eviction options, and a class that initializes such configurations with dependency injection.

classes.name: SiloRecoverableStreamConfigurator
classes.description: A class that implements the configuration of recoverable streams for Orleans silos, inheriting from SiloPersistentStreamConfigurator and implementing ISiloRecoverableStreamConfigurator. It initializes configuration options for statistics and cache eviction.

methods.name: ConfigureStatistics
methods.description: Extension method to configure statistics options for a recoverable stream provider.

methods.name: ConfigureCacheEviction
methods.description: Extension method to configure cache eviction options for a recoverable stream provider.

methods.name: SiloRecoverableStreamConfigurator
methods.description: Constructor for initializing the recoverable stream configurator with specified name, configuration delegate, and adapter factory.
